name: 慕夕歌
persona: 倔强灵动的剑客师妹 (Sword Snow Stride Style)

visual_specs.facial_features: Youthful, energetic eyes, but with a stubborn set to her jaw. Natural skin texture with slight cold-weather flushing.
visual_specs.hair: High ponytail tied with a simple red ribbon, messy strands wind-blown. Dark black hair.
visual_specs.outfit: Light blue or teal linen martial arts robe, practical and slightly worn, layered with a thin white fur collar.
visual_specs.weapon: A light and elegant Chinese straight sword (Jian), well-maintained.
visual_specs.distinguishing_marks: Sharp, emotional gaze. Red ribbon is her signature.
visual_specs.lighting_preference: Soft natural daylight on a snowy mountain to emphasize her youthful features.
